BiblicalUsage: Job says man binds the floods from overflowing, and the thing that is hid he brings forth to light. Zophar says God knows the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to what is; and the psalmist asks, shall not God search this out, for He knows the secrets of the heart. The word is a hidden thing, a secret: what lies under the water, under the surface, and under the heart.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that hidden things belong to God in a way that steadies me. I believe He knows the secrets of the heart — mine included — and that is not a threat but a mercy: nothing in me is hidden from the One who loves me.
